runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, found rail near 800M, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。接近八百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策略有反應。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Held up, still in rear and under pressure 200m out, stayed on down the outside, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 留後。二百米處仍居後列，受催策。沿外疊保持走勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Awkward start, chased leader, dropped away quickly from 500m out, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。自五百米處起迅速墮退，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Fast into stride from draw 1 to take the lead, pressed by rival early and middle stages, struggled to keep up passing 300M, faded towards the finish. (Jockey - unsuited by being pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。早段及中段被對手追迫。跑過三百米處時掙扎上前。接近終點時轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下被追迫不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, traveled fairly, slightly weakened over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢一般，末段略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Sent to forward to lead, kept on nicely without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked pace, pushed along turning into home straight, weakened gradually.
(Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時受推策。末段逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Forced to steady shortly after start, raced in rear of mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被迫收慢，居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from gate 11, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 400M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自第十一檔起步後留居後列，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Rear of mid-field, short of room bend, headway once clear over 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎空位不足。三百米處望空後隨即上前。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，僅以頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway 400m out, unable to sustain and flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前。未能保持走勢，最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat on pace, weakened final 150M. (See Incident Report)
Substantial blood.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(1W2W) 居前列。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon prominent from wide draw, led after 500m, still led by over two lengths 200m out, gradually closed down, headed 50m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即居前列位置。過了五百米處後領放。二百米處仍領先逾兩個馬位。其後逐漸被追近，五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Wide in prominent position early, obtained 2nd 2-wide over 1000M out, unable to quicken under pressure in home straight and kept on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下未能加速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide from 900M, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。自九百米處起走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Outpaced in rear, pushed along 450m out, short of room and forced to steady top of home straight, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。四百五十米處受推策。直路初空位不足，被迫收慢。末段未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, ridden before settling in 10th on rail saving ground turning into straight, made up good ground under pressure despite inconvenienced over 50M out, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，在催策下居第十位，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下追前甚多，五十米處受妨礙。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sluggish start, pushed up to race in rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 300m, in contention and every chance final 150m, bumped by rival late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，受推策上前，居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。最後一百五十米持續拼鬥，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被對手碰撞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 700m out, clear run top of home straight, one paced under pressure, briefly hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自七百米處起受催策以保持位置。直路初望空，在催策下保持同速。接近終點時一度受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W1W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W1W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Dropped back on jumping from draw 14, raced as the back-marker throughout, had big task in hand 400M but couldn't make any progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十四檔躍出，墮後。沿途居包尾位置。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure home straight, in third place briefly over 100m out, outpaced final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受催策，保持走勢。一百米處一度居第三位。最後五十米速度不及前列馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Keen under restraint in mid-field, short-lived headway over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在受約束下搶口，居中間位置。二百米處一度追前。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。搶口。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off some weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Checked shortly after start, remained in last few to straight, shifted wide for a run making home turn but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久勒避。入直路前仍居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時移出外疊取位，但未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Away only fairly, from pole position settled in the box-seat trail, closed off just fairly when shaken up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居包廂位置。末段在催策下衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Mid-division, had to angle out for a run 300m out, soon lost ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處須向外移出取位，瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to chase leaders 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact at start, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時與他駒互相觸碰。居包尾位置，中段落後約七個馬位。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, under pressure 500m out, jockeys had concerns with its action, eased off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處受催策。騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮，因而收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路早段略為追前。二百米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail and waited with, snuck closer on the inside after straightening but ran out of room from 300M out and forced to check and stumbled over 100M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上，走內欄。入直路後在內疊追近，但自三百米處起空位不足。一百米處被迫勒避，失蹄，從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。二百五十米處未能再加速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Slowly into stride, driven to recover and take up prominent position, led halfway, two lengths clear 300m out, ran on well for pressure, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。受催策以恢復走勢，居前列。半程時領先。三百米處領先兩個馬位。在催策下走勢良佳，一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 700M, 1/2L back turning in, took the lead 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W) 起步後不久與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後追近，入直路時落後半個馬位。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages and switched wide, under pressure 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口及移出外疊。五百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受推策。入直路時走外疊，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, some headway halfway out, made up some late ground against far rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。半程時略為追前。末段沿外欄略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked pace, took closer order from halfway but three wide, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自半程起進佔較接近位置，但走第三疊。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last 2 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway on bend, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, awkwardly placed near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時處於窘境。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made minor headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4Ls back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent early, gradually shifted back to worse than midfield in 9th, inconvenienced when tempo slackened 800M out, baulked until clear run 300M out near the centre of the track, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，逐漸墮居中間之後的第九位。八百米處在步速減慢時受妨礙。受困直至三百米處望空，靠近跑道中央競跑。末段以穩勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Out with rest, raced behind midfield, nearer to the middle track, 4 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。中段落後四個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield one off the fence, one paced to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W1W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, sent forward after entering the back straight, took the lead approaching 750M, led by 1-3/4L turning in, peaked and headed near 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後受催策上前。趨近七百五十米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。接近一百五十米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Bumped and lost balance exiting stalls, tracked leaders, short of room early in home straight, clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。直路早段空位不足。二百米處望空。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made minor progress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in last few on rail after moderate start, baulked behind runners from the 800M and forced to check 700M out, fought on steadily from one of the widest into straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，受催策，居最後數位內，走內欄。自八百米處起在馬匹之後受困，七百米處被迫勒避。入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一，持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Ridden to midfield some 5L back in 6th about 1100M out, slightly worse rounding home bend, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 受催策，居中間位置。約千一米處居第六位，落後約五個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮後。直路上受催策，但未能加速，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初加速，取得領先。二百米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 1/2L back, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，落後半個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, found rail near 400M, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時移入內欄。入直路後固守內欄，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W2W) Away with them, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield early, sent forward after passing 1250M, 2nd in the middle stages, peaked on run near 500M, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。跑過一千二百五十米處後受催策上前，中段居第二位。接近五百米處時未能再加速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (6W4W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(6W4W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer on turn, 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路初在催策下反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, similar position on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, never better than midfield, one paced under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Checked and lost ground leaving stalls, raced in rear, ridden top of home straight, stayed on well final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時勒避及失地，居後列。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear after awkward start, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。入直路時難以望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 650m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百五十米處起在催策下保持位置。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Attempted to make all, kicked some 2L clear on straightening, caught close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 嘗試一放到底。入直路時加速帶離約兩個馬位。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, kicked three lengths clear top of home straight, weakened final 200m, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速帶離三個馬位。最後二百米轉弱。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, set strong pace, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，在快步速領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling just worse than midfield in 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後第九位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Pressed leader, bumped and lost balance 300m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處發生碰撞，失去平衡。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival in middle stages, quickened to a clear lead early straight, kept on well just only to be caught near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段受一駒追迫。直路早段加速帶離對手，保持佳勢，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages, unable to hold position final bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，中段搶口。直路彎未能保持位置。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Settled in last few, commenced move home bend switching wide into straight, ran on well down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 居最後數位之內。直路彎開始上前。入直路時移出外疊。在跑道中央以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 2 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後兩個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, hampered near 700M, 5 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
(Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後五個馬位，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。
（左後腿管骨部位有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, weakened inside 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled one-out-one-back over 2L back, commenced move on straightening, ran on dourly to snatch victory close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居第二疊第二位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時開始上前。力拼，接近終點時取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, unable to quicken 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處未能加速，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Sat 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off nicely, just lost in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Wide in mid-field, keen mid-race, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in first few, drifted over 2L back in 5th 800M out, slightly worse into straight but recovered some late ground closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 受催策，居前列。八百米處墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時略為墮後，但末段收復部分失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Jumped well, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, switched to chase leaders into home straight, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時轉換跑線，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon in front setting the pace, pressured in the lead by rivals from 700M, run ended mid-straight and gave way.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放，主宰步速。自七百米處起在領放下受對手追迫。直路中段無以為繼，墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped cleanly, vied for lead first half of the race, couldn't quicken passing 400M, faded away final 200M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘俐落。賽事前半段爭奪領先。跑過四百米處時未能加速。最後二百米力竭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 took up early running before relinquishing the lead near 800M, retook the lead 150M but lay in forcing jockey to stop riding momentarily. Edged out to 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，於早段領先。接近八百米處時失去領先優勢。一百五十米處再次取得領先，但內閃，導致騎師一度須停止催策。接近終點時被超越，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on outer, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W) Very wide without cover after beginning from a wide barrier, made swift headway alongside race leader 900M out to be 2-wide in 2nd home bend, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W) 自外檔出閘後走大外疊，沒有遮擋。迅速上前，九百米處與領放馬並跑。直路彎居第二位，走第二疊。末段後勁不繼。最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Keen in mid-field, allowed to stride forward out wide and led 600m out, headed over 150m out, fading when tight for room closing stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置，搶口。獲許展步上前，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。末段受緊迫之際力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, keen when tempo slackened approaching first bend, snuck closer to within 5L of pace on rail in 11th into straight, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。趨近首個彎位時在步速減慢之際搶口。入直路時沿欄追近至第十一位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。末段追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Broke well before settling in rear of midfield, became worse in 8th rounding home bend, ran on well under pressure near the centre of the track to claim 3rd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時居後列第八位。末段靠近跑道中央競跑，在催策下以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Away in line, ended up racing behind midfield along the 3-path, had work to do 400M but was only one paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。四百米處落後頗遠，但僅能保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and settled midfield 4-5L back, had some ground to make up turning for home but lacked a finishing kick.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位。轉入直路時仍落後頗遠，但末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on outer, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked pace against inside rail, chased winner from 300m out, unable to quite match that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿欄跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。末段未能追上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Mid-field, good headway between horses to challenge 200m out, responded well and on top final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在馬匹之間以佳勢上前展開挑戰。對催策反應良佳，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Waited with, still in rear top of home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 留力候上。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sat right behind the leader on the inside, same position on turn, kept on evenly until approaching 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎居相同位置。保持穩勢直至趨近一百五十米處。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W3W) From draw 13 caught racing wide no cover outside leaders, picked up nicely early straight and soon took over, kept finding late to hold off challenge from the 2nd. (Trainer questioned re improved performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，居領先馬匹外側，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初加速良佳，瞬即帶頭競跑。末段持續加速，力拒亞軍馬匹的挑戰掄元。（練馬師被查詢有關此駒的進步表現。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, weakened quickly over 300m out, eased final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處迅速轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Waited with in mid-field, pushed along when tight for room 200m out, no impression when again short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，留力候上。二百米處受推策，但受緊迫。末段再度缺乏空位，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後競跑，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear, made modest progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths back, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後六個馬位。轉入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden 3-wide in midfield early stages, 6th 2-wide rounding home bend, ran on in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時居第六位，走第二疊。直路上追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Gradually settled in midfield and wide without cover, remained in similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Raced in touch, keen to halfway, good headway from 300m out, led 100m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，半程前搶口。自三百米處起追前甚多。一百米處取得領先，末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Mid-field, three wide, stayed on steadily final 300m, overhauled runner-up to lead late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米保持穩勢。末段超越亞軍馬匹，取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Settled midfield 2 wide, switched out turning for Home, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段追前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Average to begin, positioned 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, wider turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward around first bend to join leaders 3-wide, obtained 2-wide position 800M out, faded steadily out of contention after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 受催策上前。首次轉彎時追上領先馬匹，走第三疊。八百米處走第二疊。入直路後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened in the final strides. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，直至最後數步轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (5W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen, brief effort early in home straight, soon weakened.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(5W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。搶口。直路早段一度發力，瞬即轉弱。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, made good progress final 200M to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 700M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居前列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時讓對手過頭。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
Respiratory condition.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走外疊。其後未能推進。
異常呼吸狀況。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field against far rail, ridden along halfway out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外欄。半程時受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear of mid-field on outer, pushed along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，離外欄競跑。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, faded under pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。最後二百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened final 150M.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。最後一百五十米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, driven along 450m out, hung out final 400m, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。最後四百米外閃。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, took the early lead, headed 600M, 2nd on turn, peaked 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領放。六百米處被超越。直路彎居第二位。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Sat on pace 2 wide, weakened final 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居前列，走第二疊。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, no clear room in the Straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped exiting stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策。超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Knuckled over shortly after the start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步後不久俯首前跪，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Knuckled at start, three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 起步時俯首前跪，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (6W1W) Crowded shortly after start, dropped out from wide draw, followed runner-up through in home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(6W1W) 自外檔起步後不久受擠迫，墮後。直路上跟隨亞軍馬匹上前，衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, steadied for cover halfway out, bumped 350m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時收慢以取得遮擋。三百五十米處發生碰撞。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路上迅速墮退，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat handy, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced at center behind midfield, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, peaked on run 500M, weakened gradually in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, forced to steady 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。一百米處被迫收慢，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled handy, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out after passing 550M, taken wide in straight and finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走第二疊。跑過五百五十米處後向外移出。直路上移出外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat rear, switched out rounding the Turn, had difficulty obtaining clear running near 200M, steady ground made from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。接近二百米處時難以望空。末段自後列穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, raced green, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。走勢稚嫩，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled behind the lead on the rail, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sat towards the rear, no clear run, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列。未能望空。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, pushed along 600m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in rear of mid-field against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，走外欄。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide from 600M, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (5W2W2W) Made contact at start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, a bit closer on turn but still 8 lengths behind, made very good progress in straight to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(5W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追前，但仍落後八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Crowded at start, three wide in mid-field, forced to steady 850m out and raced very wide, stayed on well in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第三疊。八百五十米處被迫收慢，走大外疊。直路上保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the lead, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 5Ls back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Away well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 1400m out, dropped to last place 600m out, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。千四米處一度受阻礙。六百米處墮居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W3W) 3-wide without cover in 5th just better than midfield, came under pressure to hold place inside the 700M but lost position out wide rounding home bend, fought on steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間稍前的第五位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處受催策以保持位置，但轉直路彎時走外疊，失位。直路上以穩勢力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, switched wide for clear run 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百米處移出外疊望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢，最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Per Incanto out of the O’Reilly mare Second Obsession. Horses by the same sire include Healthy Healthy and Raging Blizzard. This fellow was given four trials for one win and three placings in Hong Kong. He was taken back and won by 3/4L under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second, beaten by 3/4L, under the whip over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 12. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Per Incanto之後，在港同父馬包括「添開心」及「精算暴雪」等駒，生母出自O’Reilly。抵港後四次試閘得一勝三位。11月2日出試從化草地1200米，起步居後，末段力策下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。最近11月12日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段鞭策下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Toronado out of the Sebring mare Palumbo. Horses by the same sire include Little Paradise and Red Elegance. This fellow was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fifth, beaten by 2Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「豪華房車」(Toronado)之後，在港同父馬包括「小鳥天堂」及「紅逸舍」等駒，生母出自「識奔」(Sebring)。抵港後試閘三次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Jumped only fairly, settled behind mid-division 5-6Ls back, swung wide into straight before closing off the race moderately. Went 4th close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後五至六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊，衝剌普通。接近終點時上前取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 250M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空。二百五十米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W6W) From a wide draw dropped back to near the rear early stages, brought widest 500M from home, came with a big run from well back to get into the placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W6W) 自外檔出閘，早段留居後列。五百米處移出最外疊。自遙遙落後的位置大幅追前，進佔季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the stands' rail, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after the start, raced rear division of mid-field 3 wide with cover, finished off just fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Tracked leader, three wide, effort over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處發力上前。最後二百五十米再無餘力，墮退。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Spirit Of Boom out of the Darci Brahma mare Our Miss Jones. Horses by the same sire include The Boom Box and Causeway King. This fellow was given four trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and won by 1L, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth, beaten by 2Ls, under slight pressure over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 13. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「昌盛繁榮」(Spirit Of Boom)之後，在港同父馬包括「膨才」及「高士威勁」等駒，生母出自「達先寶馬」(Darci Brahma)。抵港後四次試閘得兩勝。10月5日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以一個馬位之先勝出。最近11月13日出試田泥1050米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along from wide draw to lead, disputed led middle stages, headed early in home straight, weakened final 250m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下領放。中段爭奪領先。直路初被超越。最後二百五十米轉弱。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced just off leaders, couldn't go on with leaders from 250M, swamped further on as effort wound down final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。自二百五十米處起未能跟上領先馬匹。末段力竭，被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced in 2nd , 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W1W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, keen under restraint, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。在約束下搶口。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Followed leader to get across, chased leader, ridden top of home straight, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬以切入，追趕領放馬。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Crowded and heavily bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生大力碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began fairly, ended up racing in last over 8Ls off the pace, had big task in hand turning home, made some progress in the straight without posing threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾八個馬位。轉入直路時落後甚遠。直路上略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back turning in, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居包尾位置。入直路時落後約七個馬位。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 500M, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 550M, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Raced in touch, clear run towards inside rail and some headway 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。望空，走內欄。三百米處略為追前。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, some late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受催策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped at start, tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘稍慢，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, travelling smoothly but had to wait for a run in home straight, switched 150m out, ran on well to claim second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。走勢暢順，但在直路上須等待空位出現。一百五十米處轉換跑線。以佳勢上前，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear on the rail, switched out entering the Straight, made steady progress to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。末段穩步上前。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W6W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide with cover, turned very wide into the home straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, did not finish off after being crowded near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。接近三百米處時受擠迫，其後未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced at tail, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺凌厲。掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, not far from leaders early before easing back to midfield, worked into the race well 400M, ran on solidly to get amongst the placings.
sustained a laceration to the left hind fetlock.
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: sustained a laceration to the left hind fetlock.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出。早段落後領先馬匹不遠，其後收慢留居中間位置。四百米處以佳勢上前。末段衝刺不俗，跑獲季軍。
左後球節割傷。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成任何威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W2W) Wide early from high draw, led after 400m, headed 600m out, remained prominent until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段走外疊。跑了四百米後取得領先。六百米處被超越。仍居前列，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped ok, sat midfield one off the rail, hit the line strongly when asked, just missed by a whisker.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下衝刺強勁，僅以短馬頭位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Began well from a middle draw, settled down 2-wide in midfield, lay in when placed under pressure in the home straight, ran to the line steadily for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下內閃。末段以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, pushed along bend, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受推策。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, forced to steady 900m out, effort 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處被迫收慢。四百米處發力，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W) Away well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, ridden along 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly and raced at the back, struggled to keep up with rivals middle stages, couldn't go on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段難以跟上對手。最後四百米無以為繼。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by El Roca out of the Iffraaj mare La Landonne. Horses by the same sire include Circuit Duffy and Top To Sky. This fellow was given eight trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished sixth, beaten by 2Ls, under the whip over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「穩如盤石」(El Roca)之後，在港同父馬包括「綫路達飛」及「天比高」等駒，生母出自Iffraaj。抵港後試閘八次。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段鞭策下跑第六名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian ISG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Written Tycoon out of the More Than Ready mare Glamour Cat. Horses by the same sire include Jumbo Treasure and Tomodachi Kokoroe. This fellow was given four trials for one win in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 2Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 19. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「千秋巨子」(Written Tycoon)之後，在港同父馬包括「寶進」及「好友心得」等駒，生母出自「超妥當」(More Than Ready)。抵港後四次試閘得一勝。最近11月19日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下以兩個馬位之先勝出。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand ISG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Savabeel out of the O’Reilly mare Simply You. Horses by the same sire include Super Unicorn and Good Good. This fellow was given four trials for four placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished third, beaten by 5-1/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third, beaten by a neck, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 13. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「小法寶」(Savabeel)之後，在港同父馬包括「勁好運」及「小飛俠」等駒，生母出自O’Reilly。抵港後四次試閘四次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬5.25個馬位。最近11月13日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Taken back early, sat near the rear 3 wide, stayed on fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 早段留後，居後列，走第三疊。保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, headway into contention 300m out, stuck to task.
sustained a small abrasion to the right hind leg.
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: sustained a small abrasion to the right hind leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處上前爭勝。持續力拼。
右後腿輕微擦傷。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Broke well from a wide barrier but taken backward to behind midfield 3-wide, taken wider into straight, obtained a clear run 300M out and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出更外疊。三百米處望空，以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually settling in 8th for cover just inside the 1100M, slightly further back in quickened pace 800M out, ran on steadily inside final 400M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速。跑過千一米處後逐漸居第八位以取得遮擋。八百米處略為進一步落後步速加快的領放馬。最後四百米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well before being restrained to a midfield position 4-5Ls off the pace, fought on steadily final 400M but was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。最後四百米持續力拼，但一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。未能望空直至二百五十米處。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, good headway on bend, sustained headway early in home straight to challenge leaders, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎追前甚多。直路初持續上前挑戰領先馬匹。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Away from the stalls swiftly, soon let the speed go sat midfield along the rail, hit the line strongly only just went down by a whisker (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，瞬即放棄爭奪領先，居中間位置，走內欄。末段衝刺強勁，僅以短距離落敗。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on final 250m, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百五十米保持走勢，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Across from wide draw to race outside of leader, stayed prominent until 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入內疊，居領放馬外側。保持居前列直至二百米處。其後力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, headway up rail final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米沿欄上前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Prominent early stages, lost position dropping to 5th home bend, renewed effort into straight, weakened inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。直路彎失位，墮居第五位。入直路時重新發力。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped on terms, close up with leaders early stages before dropping back to race ahead of midfield passing 700M, ran on well early straight but run ended 150M from home and faded away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段緊隨領先馬匹。跑過七百米處時墮居中間之前位置。直路初走勢良佳，但一百五十米處無以為繼，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch, headway to challenge 200m out, every chance and led briefly final 100m, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處追前以展開挑戰。最後一百米一度取得領先，末段保持走勢，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along 700m out, short of room from 350m out to 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受推策。三百五十米處至二百米處之間空位不足。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in mid-division, shuffled back on bend, made up some ground home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路彎墮退。直路上略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, stuck to inside rail, under pressure over 300m out, unable to quicken, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，固守內欄。三百米處受催策，但未能加速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Began only fairly from the widest draw, raced in midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, dropped towards rear approaching 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。趨近五百米處時墮居後列。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide in midfield, peaked turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 起步時被碰撞，失去平衡，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時未能再增速。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, hampered near 850M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自第十檔出閘後留居中間位置，走外疊。接近八百五十米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, raced wide and without cover, weakened over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。末段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped ok and settled slightly worse than midfield, made minor progress final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Shifted out at start and bumped, raced at rear on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居後列，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sped to the lead and crossed to the stands' side 600M, fought on well when placed under pressure, lost lead inside 200M, faded to 5th close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;加速上前領先。六百米處切向外欄，受催策以佳勢力拼。最後二百米失去領先，接近終點時力竭，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W1W) Bumped out of stalls, showed speed to get across, kicked 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，展現前速以切入內疊。三百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後持續力拼。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Attempted to make all from a wide draw but swamped when found no extra inside final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後嘗試一放到底，但最後二百五十米再無餘力，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Soon led, crossed for rails run inside the 900M setting a fast pace on the bend, unable to sustain effort and headed 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 瞬即領放。九百米處切入內欄。直路彎以快步速領放，但三百米處後繼無力及被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Taken across to make running against stand rail, ridden over 200m out, challenged final 100m, always doing enough to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;切向外欄，沿外欄帶頭競跑。二百米處受催策。最後一百米受挑戰，但一直保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Soon led along the stand rail after a clean jump, broke away from the field passing 400M, kept on strongly to the line for a wide margin victory. (Jockey fined for returning 2 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘俐落，瞬即帶頭，走外欄。跑過四百米處時帶離馬群。保持勁勢至終點，大勝而回。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅兩磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Began well from a wide barrier travelling very wide without cover in 6th, remained 4-wide without cover rounding home bend, weakened out of contention inside final 500M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第六位，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時持續走第四疊，沒有遮擋。最後五百米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Travelled 3-wide without cover in prominent positions, weakened shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路後不久轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased the leader, gave ground quickly passing 200M, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。跑過二百米處時迅速墮退。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear but failed to run on under top weight. Never in the picture. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，但在負頂磅下未能追前。從未有力一爭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Blundered shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 950M, challenged by rival turning in, headed early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時取得領先。轉入直路時受對手挑戰。直路初被超越，其後轉弱。
