runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in 3rd, some 4L off the fast pace rounding home bend, kept on at the same pace early in straight but swamped for a placing inside final 80M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第三位。轉直路彎時落後步速甚快的領放馬約四個馬位。直路早段保持同速，但最後八十米被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W1W1W) Began well, took up running off the rail attempting to make all, obtained rails run about 600M out, unable to sustain effort and headed over 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，離欄領放，嘗試一放到底。約六百米處移入內欄。二百米處無以為繼，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, pressed in front, pressed on 350m out, headed by winner 50m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。三百五十米處受催策。五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Moderately away, raced 2 better than midfield in the early stages, found rail approaching 800M, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。趨近八百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well and raced in a share of lead, ridden and opened up clear advantage from 300m out, just kept up to work final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，並排領先。自三百米處起受催策及拋離對手。最後五十米僅保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along 400m out to chase leaders, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened early to lead 350m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。率先加速，三百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Gradually settled in midfield, commenced move inside the 400M, ran on under pressure to gain upper hand over 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 逐漸居中間位置。四百米處開始上前。末段在催策下追前。五十米處佔得上風，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field with cover, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, 5Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處落後五個馬位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W5W) Out in line, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled handy on the rail, checked near 350M, not much impression made. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。接近三百五十米處時勒避。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, responded nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策，取得領先。走勢暢順。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, 2 wide, found rail near 700M, led by a length turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放，走第二疊。接近七百米處時切入內欄，入直路時領先一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，趨近一百米處時未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Knuckled over on jumping and became unbalanced, raced prominently on the outside, a length back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 躍出時俯首前跪，失去平衡，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個馬位，直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前帶頭。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon led, took them along at good pace first half of the race, had 1L advantage going into final 400M, headed nearing 200M, faded towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放。前半程以快步速帶頭競跑。進入最後四百米時領先一個馬位。接近二百米處時被超越。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a moderate start attempting to make all, unable to sustain effort under pressure inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即領放，嘗試一放到底。最後一百米在催策下無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Settled just better than midfield in 5th within 3L of pace, ran on steadily inside final 200M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間稍前第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。最後二百米以穩勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Restrained to race at the back of the main group about 4Ls off the pace, ran home fairly and was never going the pace to challenge leaders.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 受約束，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬約四個馬位。末段衝刺一般。從未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Given a waiting ride towards the rear, 4Ls to make up 400M, closed off well to take 4th close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)居後列，留力候上。四百米處落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，接近終點時進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, keen middle stages, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置。中段搶口。五百米處受催策。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Blundered out of stalls, held up, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時失蹄，留後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled down midfield 3Ls off leaders, ran on steadily final 300M for 3rd but couldn't quite get to first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍，但未能追上首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from the one draw gradually settling some 2L back in 4th or 3rd on rail, soon came to challenge on straightening holding every chance over 150M out, swamped for a placing in final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，逐漸居第三或第四位，落後約兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時瞬即展開挑戰。一百五十米處一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後數步被超越，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Stayed close to leaders towards outside of the field, couldn't sustain run final 200M and faded closing stages. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;保持緊隨領先馬匹，在馬群外側競跑。最後二百米後繼無力，末段力竭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away fast, restrained to race in midfield, brought wide in the straight and closed off strongly to lead close home. (Trainer - advantaged by racing over HV 1000M where it had performed well.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。直路上移至外疊。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。（練馬師表示，此駒今仗角逐以往表現良佳的跑馬地一千米賽事，有利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 went forward tracking leader, couldn't keep passing 300M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。跑過三百米處時未能跟上，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven to the lead setting even pace up front, headed by pursuing rivals nearing 200M, weakened badly final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策以取得領先，以平穩步速帶頭。接近二百米處時被緊追的對手超越。末段嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Stumbled leaving stalls, recovered to track leading pair, weakened over 300m out, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘時失蹄，恢復走勢後跟隨領先兩駒。最後三百米轉弱。末段被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Bumped at the start, moved up to race behind the runaway leader, battled to hold 2nd early straight, no extra final 150M losing several places in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，上前，居遙遙領先的領放馬之後。直路初力拼以保住第二位。最後一百五十米再無餘力。末段失去數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat towards the rear, stayed on well to grab 2nd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Made contact at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until 250M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。未能望空直至二百五十米處。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in rear of midfield on the rail, drifted slightly worse approaching home bend, ran on from 8th into straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。趨近直路彎時略為墮後。入直路時自第八位追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken well back early from a wide barrier, ridden forward to reach 9th towards rear inside the 700M remaining 3-wide without cover to straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段遙居於後。受催策上前，七百米處進佔後列的第九位。直路前仍走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped in line, dropped back to sit behind mid-division, brought widest for his challenge in the straight, closed off well to go 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，墮居中間之後位置。直路上移至最外疊展開挑戰。衝刺良佳，接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly settling over 2L back in 6th on rail, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend switching off the rail for a run, ran on steadily inside final 150M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居第六位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠，移離內欄取位。最後一百五十米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, 4 lengths back on turn, closed off well to take 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段留居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，過終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W4W) Wide without cover in rear of midfield after beginning from the widest barrier, soon weakened in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, short of room top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初空位不足。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W) Chased leaders along the fence, within striking distance turning home, responded well and dug deep final 200M to overhaul the long-time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。入直路時落後領放馬不遠。最後二百米對催策反應良佳，持續力拼，接近終點時超越沿途帶頭的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed near 250M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。接近二百五十米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Quickly away, soon in front and led uncontested to the straight, headed mid-straight then faded to finish 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，瞬即帶頭，單騎領放至直路。直路中段被超越，其後力竭，以第四名過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Badly crowded at start losing ground and dropping to the rear, similar into home straight, ran on strongly down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，失地，墮居後列。入直路時位置相若。直路上在跑道中央以勁勢追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped on terms, soon race in a forward spot just off the pace, driven to lead inside 250M, fought on late to hold off runner up in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，瞬即居前列，緊隨領放馬。二百五十米處在催策下領先。末段力拼，在短兵相接下力拒亞軍馬匹取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure throughout, lacked pace to challenge up rail in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。沿途受催策。直路上走內欄，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped back form wide draw to race in a position near last, wide into straight but couldn't quite finish off in the straight. (Jockey : disadvantaged by settling back in the field.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居接近包尾位置。入直路時走外疊。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（騎師表示，坐騎居後列，不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, raced keenly, raced very wide throughout, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。搶口。沿途走大外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, urged along early stages to stay in touch with the field 4 back the fence, dashed home when winner was off and gone.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，早段受催策以跟上馬群，落後四個馬位，走內欄。末段發力衝刺，但頭馬已加速帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Pressed leader, ridden along to challenge leader 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策以挑戰領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure 700m out to chase leaders, outpaced and gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。七百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。未能跟上步速，最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續追前。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, hit the front approaching 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。趨近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一頸位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on outer, there to turn, hampered early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段受阻礙，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Dropped back to near last on settling, had plenty to do top of the straight, couldn't finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 墮居至接近包尾位置。直路初落後甚遠。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, towards rear, stayed on under pressure, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，居後列，走外疊。在催策下保持走勢。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) Jumped with the field, settled at the rear of midfield one off the fence, kicked strongly in the final 200M under reminders to grab rivals in the final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下加速強勁，最後一步追過對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled wide, hampered when being taken wider inside 300M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。三百米處在被帶出較外疊之際受阻礙。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and lost ground leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, hampered against rail 800m out, gave ground in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後向外斜跑及失地，居中間位置，走內欄。八百米處沿欄受阻礙。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上受困，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start settling in rear of midfield on rail, about 5L off the lead in 9th home bend, tight run in 7th after straightening, kept on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎居第九位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。入直路後緊迫競跑，居第七位。在催策下保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled towards rear on rail, gained slightly closer around home bend, angled out for a clear run 300M out, responded well under pressure and asserted authority just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時略為追近。三百米處向外移出以望空。在催策下反應良佳，跑過一百米處後主宰大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 700M, 3 wide on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。過了七百米處後略為追近。直路彎走第三疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide 550m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處開始上前，走外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W2W) Hampered leaving stalls, mid-field, keen mid-race, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘時受阻礙，居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處受推策，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Shifted in abruptly at start and bumped, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時急促向內斜跑，發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Held up from high draw, taken widest entering home straight, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時移出最外疊。保持走勢。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, kept chasing in the Straight, nothing extra final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上持續追趕。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Settled in last few and waited with, went wide into home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。直路上在跑道中央受催策上前。以末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slowly away and checked soon after start, outpaced and detached from main body of runners, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後瞬即勒避。未能跟上步速，被主馬群拋離。從未見具競爭力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (9W2W2W) Outpaced and settled in the last few, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(9W2W2W) 未能跟上步速，居最後數位之內。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear on the stands' side, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般。留居後列，靠近外欄競跑。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slow out, settled behind midfield along the inside, closed off mildly from 300M but couldn't be ridden out final 100M. (Rider had made error of judgement in not improving position sooner than what he did early straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自三百米處起衝刺普通，但最後一百米未能被力策。（騎師於直路初未有較實際更早讓坐騎推進上前屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear, pushed along halfway, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。半程時受推策。末段被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Drifted back to race near the rear after jumping, had the job ahead 400M and couldn't make any headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 躍出後墮居後列。四百米處仍落後甚遠，其後未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat towards the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W4W) Sat rear, improved and switched out approaching the corner, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W4W) 居後列。趨近直路彎時推進及向外移出。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled towards rear, fought on steadily in home straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路上持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed approaching 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 躍出時被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Crossed to the lead 1000M setting good pace in the middle stages, had 1L lead and still going well mid-straight, run ended 100M out and caught by pursuers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 一千米處切入帶頭，中段以快步速領放。直路中段領先一個馬位，走勢仍佳。一百米處無以為繼，被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace, ridden some 3L clear about 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放。約一百五十米處受催策，帶離約三個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。末段以勁勢上前，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 900M, 4 wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過九百米處後略為追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 500m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Taken back from a wide barrier to last or near last, saved ground on rail turning in for home, only produced modest impression under pressure in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾或接近包尾位置。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段在催策下僅略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Shifted out and bumped at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in last few from a wide barrier, baulked behind runners upon straightening, eventually obtained a clear run over 150M out, produced good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內。入直路時在馬群之後受困。一百五十米處望空，末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, settled at the tail of the field 7-8L, switched wide turning for home and had work to do, made some progress without threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置，落後七至八個馬位。轉入直路時移出外疊，落後頗遠。其後略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along 600m out, hampered and lost balance 250m out, eased off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受推策。二百五十米處受阻礙，失去平衡。收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some limited headway when running out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。末段略為追前，最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, held up between 400M to 300M, responded reasonably well when placed under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間受困。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out, made contact and lost ground out of stalls, held up last, switched inside for clear run early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 躍出時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰及失地，留居包尾位置。直路初向內移入以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W3W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled greenly, raced wide and without cover, never a danger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢稚嫩。走外疊，沒有遮擋。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百五十米處未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙及與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, switched wide for clear run 250m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, still well back on turn, angled out 350M, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, headway 300m out, stayed on well final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處追前。最後一百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, dropped to last pair into home straight, strong run between horses from 300m out, edged ahead close home, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。自三百米處起在馬匹之間衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 400M, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Made running, raced keenly, drew away early stages, headed by winner 600m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑，搶口。早段帶離對手。六百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear top of home straight, headed by winner 50m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初加速帶離兩個馬位。五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, short of room in home straight, clear run 100m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路上空位不足。一百米處望空。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Hampered at start dropping to last few, came under pressure over 500M out to challenge into the straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時受阻礙，墮居最後數位之內。五百米處受催策以在入直路時展開挑戰。在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in last few after a moderate start and waited with in 8th some 6L off the pace, commenced move approaching home turn and finished off the race well inside final 150M, did beset work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘普通，其後居後列第八位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, followed runner-up through 600m out, hung in but ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段內閃，但衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide turning in, kept on very well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。入直路時走第二疊。直路上保持甚佳走勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide without cover early stages, improved to get cover on bend, strong run early in home straight to lead 300m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 早段走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎上前取得遮擋。直路上走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, short of room top of home straight, ridden along 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初空位不足。三百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start, across to press leader, quickened early to lead 550m out, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，切入追逼領放馬。早段加速，五百五十米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, pressed on 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處受催策。二百米處衝刺強勁，取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, commenced move 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處開始發力。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, quickened early to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 800M, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起走第三疊。五百米處向外移出，直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, raced in last pair, clear run 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，居最後兩位之內。四百米處望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground and settling well behind, tight 300M out and switched out for a run 200M out, produced good late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，遙居於後。三百米處受緊迫。二百米處向外移出以取位。末段追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Bumped start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, held up behind midfield, swung wide from 500M, kept on steadily to the line without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置。自五百米處起移出外疊。保持穩勢至終點，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced slightly better than midfield, no cover throughout, 1-3/4L back turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後一又四分三馬位。衝刺凌厲，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to just worse than midfield mostly in 9th on rail, travelled keenly home bend and forced to steady 600M out, not much room early in straight, obtained a clear run 260M out, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，大多居中間稍後的第九位，走內欄。直路彎搶口，六百米處被迫收慢。直路早段空位不足，二百六十米處望空，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along to chase leaders on bend, ran on well to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎在推策下追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。末段受亞軍馬匹追迫，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。未能空直至三百五十米處。以佳勢追前，最後五十米取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Box seat, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置，未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, headway between horses from 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起在馬匹之間追前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out shortly after start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 250M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, checked at the 800M, took some time to respond in the Straight, made very good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。八百米處勒避。直路上需時對催策作出反應。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Slowly away, settled in mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置。直路初向外移出以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W2W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1050M, sat outside the leader on turn, retook the lead 400M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W2W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前領放。一千零五十米處被超越。直路彎居領放馬外側。四百米處重奪領先位置。保持佳勢至終點獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, quickened early in home straight to kick five lengths clear 200m out, eased close home and won impressively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以取得領先。直路初加速，二百米處帶離五個馬位。接近終點時收慢，勝姿悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace on rail, drew over 3L clear upon straightening, eased closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放，走內欄。入直路時帶離逾三個馬位。末段在收慢下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) From draw 14 went forward, in 3rd spot going into home turn, briefly in front 350M but couldn't hold off the first 3 finishers mid-straight, no extra late under top weight and lost 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後上前。進入直路彎時居第三位。三百五十米處一度領先，但直路中段未能抗衡三甲馬匹。在負頂磅下末段再無餘力，接近終點時失去第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) In the group chasing leaders early stages, raced keenly and allowed to move closer to the pace passing 1000M, ran on same pace in the straight, lost 2nd inside 100M, weakened to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，搶口，跑過一千米處時獲許上前追近領放馬。直路上保持同速。一百米處失去第二位，其後轉弱，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W5W) Raced in rear after crowded and bumped out of stalls, headway halfway into mid-field, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W5W) 出閘時受擠迫及發生碰撞，其後居後列。半程時追前至中間位置。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, three wide in rear without cover after forced to steady 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。九百米處被迫收慢，其後居尾列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W2W) Went forward chasing leader in a fast run race, was left without a finishing effort in the home straight, weakened to last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 在快步速下上前追趕領放馬。直路上衝刺乏力。末段轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, challenged strongly final 250M but winner found the necessary to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。最後二百五十米以勁勢展開挑戰，但頭馬猶有餘力保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Had a ground saving trip from draw 2 and stayed close enough behind leaders throughout, kept on steadily when placed under pressure in the straight. Held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，走內疊節省腳程，沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上在催策下保持穩勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to get across, chased leader, driven along 500m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以切入內疊，追趕領放馬。五百米處受催策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Stayed close to leaders throughout, pace very slow in early stages, worked into the race well, tried hard to reel in first two final 300M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿途緊隨領先馬匹，早段步速非常緩慢。走勢良佳。最後三百米力拼以追及頭兩名馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Chased leaders in a slowly run race, fought hard and remained in contention until 200M then weakened towards the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，賽事步速緩慢。力拼，保持爭逐機會直至二百米處，其後於末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ridden top of home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初受催策。其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 3 raced just behind leaders throughout, fought hard to stay in contention from 300M, couldn't accelerate enough final 150M and made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，沿途居領先馬匹稍後位置。自三百米處起力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米加速力不足，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, moved up to challenge 400M, badly crowded between rivals 150M before fading away over concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處在馬匹之間嚴重受擠迫。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 500m out, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。五百米處受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Away on terms, moved up to be tracking the pace on outside, kept up the chase on leader turning home, fought hard but was held by first two late stage. Hung on for 3rd just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。入直路時持續追趕領放馬，但末段未能追上頭兩名馬匹。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, raced in last pair, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，居最後兩位之內。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, under pressure 400m out, ran on well, promising.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。四百米處受催策。末段以佳勢追前。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, sustained headway in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處開始上前，走外疊。直路上持續追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處受推策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Dropped back to the rear, raced keenly with the pace of the event being run outside of standard time, 10Ls off leader 400M, couldn't make up ground.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 墮居後列，搶口，賽事步速較標準時間為慢。四百米處落後領放馬十個馬位。未能追前。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) In rear after crowded and steadied at start, pushed along widest into home straight, closed on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及收慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sluggish start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped back to race in last from a wide draw, moved closer 600M, unleashed a strong turn of foot on straightening to take lead 200M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。六百米處追近。入直路時加速強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, shuffled back, still in last place turning into home straight, strong run final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置。最後二百米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Stayed close enough behind leaders early stages, in midfield spot making the home turn, fought hard but only maintained the position. Never in the hunt.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。轉直路彎時居中間位置。力拼，但僅能保持位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in second half of the field 8Ls off leader, kept on same pace in the straight and never able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後半馬群中，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in 5th positioned in second half of the field throughout, kept on same pace in the straight posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。沿途居後半馬群的第五位。直路上保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Never better than mid-division of the small field, commenced move from over 2L back in 5th into straight but unable to make any impression throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 在九駒中從未超越中間位置。入直路時從落後逾兩個馬位的第五位開始發力，但末段全程毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position 600m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處難以保持位置。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure 450m out, taken wider into home straight, gave ground final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。入直路時被帶出更外疊。最後二百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Held a forward position outside leader, right there turning for home but peaked on his run mid-straight and failed to finish the job.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。轉直路彎時居好位，但直路中段未能再增速。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled 2-wide ahead of midfield, in touch making the turn for home, stayed on mildly towards the finish and just lost out in a photo finish for 3rd and 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居啣接位置。保持一般走勢至終點，在電眼判決下僅失季軍及第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide, 2-1/2L back, same position on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 50M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個半馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly to 350m out, strong run to lead 200m out, won comfortably and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離對手，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, held up making the home turn and early straight, obtained clear running passing 250M and closed off well enough to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。轉直路彎時及直路初受困。跑過二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, raised tempo 800m out, kicked 400m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。八百米處加快步速。四百米處加速。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, there to turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎前居相同位置，走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sluggish start, rail position in mid-field, switched wide for clear run into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時移出外疊以望空。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along on bend to maintain position, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策以保持位置。末段未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊，衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，僅以一馬頭位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, closed off well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑入季席，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to close-up 4th after the first 150M, chased leaders on rail into straight, dropped out tamely inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，過了首一百五十米後居第四位，落後不遠。入直路時追趕領先馬匹，走內欄。最後三百米乏力墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W4W) Jumped well from draw 9, caught racing 3-wide in a position ahead of midfield throughout, kept battling in the straight and narrowly missed 3rd. No threat to first two however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，沿途居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路上持續力拼，僅失季軍，但未能威脅前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stumbled leaving stalls, mid division, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時失蹄，居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure, just missed third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, chased leader, strong run to lead 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，追趕領放馬。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。拋離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped on terms from draw 1, reserved in midfield on settling, held up for clear running from 400m to 200M before finishing off well. Not ridden out close home when racing tight. Could have finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔與對手同步躍出，留居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後衝刺良佳。接近終點緊迫競跑時未能被力策。本應有望跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4Ls off the pace, into clear running 350M, stayed on fairly well to go 3rd near line. Not reach first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。三百五十米處望空。保持不俗走勢，接近終點時進佔第三位，但未能追上頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position, travelled keenly towards the rear 3-wide and no cover, couldn't go on final 300M. (Rider - did not appear to appreciate the HV circuit.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前的位置。居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，跑來搶口。最後三百米未能追前。（騎師表示坐騎未能適應在跑馬地的跑道上作賽。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in rear after slowly away, ridden top of home straight, well held from 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。直路初受催策。自二百米處起落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W2W) Driven along from stalls to press leader, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased off.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路上迅速墮退，收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, unable to match front three but stayed on for clear fourth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初受催策，追趕領放馬。未能抗衡三甲馬匹，但保持走勢，帶離餘駒，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from wide draw, across to make running, quickened over 300m out, in control final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄領放。三百米處加速。最後二百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Bumped rival after the start, obtained a midfield spot on settling, wide into straight before running on mildly for 5th without troubling first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久碰撞對手，居中間位置。入直路時走外疊，其後保持普通走勢，取得第五名，未能威脅前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home striaght, switched for clear run 150m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。一百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。末段在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Waited with in rear, raced keenly throughout, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not far off the leaders early stages, checked 750M losing ground, had 3-4Ls to make up 400M, lacked a finishing kick and was safely held in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百五十米處勒避，失地。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺乏力，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in worse than midfield and waited with, obtained a run just over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，留力候上。就在過了二百米處後取得空位上前。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 1 raced behind midfield towards the outside of the group, ran on one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘後居中間之後位置，靠近馬群外側競跑。最後四百米保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處發生碰撞。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先，勝出。

formguide.comments_eng: Argentine PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Gidu out of the Key Deputy mare Garua Key. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had eleven starts for five wins (including two listed over 1200m) and five placings. He was given four trials for one win in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and won by a nose, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 17. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: Gidu之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Key Deputy。來港前在阿根廷十一戰得五勝五位，頭馬包括兩場1200米表列賽。抵港後四次試閘得一勝。11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下以一鼻位之先勝出。最近11月17日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away well, showed good early speed to lead, kept on strongly to the line, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，展現甚快前速以領放。保持勁勢至終點。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Missed the start, sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 漏閘，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，在催策下上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, took the lead near 150M, kept on well but could not hold off the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。接近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Unbalanced after being bumped at the start. Sent forward to take the lead, travelled strongly, led by 2L turning in and all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時被碰撞，其後失去平衡。受催策上前領放，走勢強勁。入直路時領先二個馬位。一放到底，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Out in line, raced prominently, peaked on run 350M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列。三百五十米處未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W) From draw 11 obliged to race very wide outside leaders throughout, was left without a finishing effort in the final straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，沿途須在領先馬匹外側走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力及轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start, raced better than midfield on the outside in the early stages, took the lead approaching 800M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on very strongly in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑。早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。趨近八百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以兩個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure to hold position from 600m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。自六百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Up with early pace then eased to a trailing position behind leaders, fought on one paced early straight before overrun by rivals closing stages. (Jockey - instructed to go forward as it did in a barrier trial.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢，居領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。直路早段保持同速，末段被對手超越。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓坐騎如試閘時般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Frosted out of the Exceed And Excel mare Essaouira. Horses by the same sire include All’s Well and Elite Golf. This fellow had eleven starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1200m) and five placings (including a 2yo listed over 1200m). He was given two trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and won by 8Ls under a hold over 1050m AWT in Conghua on October 29. In the latest trial, he made all to win by 9-1/4Ls under a hold over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 12. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「霜降」(Frosted)之後，在港同父馬包括「亨驥」及「精英高球」等駒，生母出自「盡善盡美」(Exceed And Excel)。來港前在澳洲十一戰得一勝五位，頭馬為一場1200米三歲從未勝出馬賽，上名賽事包括一場1200米兩歲表列賽。抵港後兩次試閘全勝。10月29日出試從化泥地1050米，早段並頭領放，末段按韁下以八個馬位之先勝出。最近11月12日出試從化泥地1200米，早段領放，末段按韁下以9.25個馬位之先勝出。初出有一爭之力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) From wide draw dropped back to race as the back marker, had plenty to do 600M but responded only fairly to riding. Never in the picture. (Jockey - no explanation for his mount's disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。六百米處仍落後甚遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。從未有力一爭。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, forced to steady 400m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處被迫收慢，直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, driven along 450m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight for room against rail early in home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初沿欄受緊迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Reserved behind midfield along the inside, in similar spot 3Ls off the pace home turn before running on strongly final 300M to take lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎居相若位置，落後領放馬三個馬位。最後三百米以勁勢衝刺，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back on jumping from a wide draw, raced as the back marker 7Ls off the pace, failed to respond turning home and soon eased. (No Vet findings / Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔躍出後墮後，居包尾位置，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應，瞬即收慢。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat midfield, checked at 150M, never involved afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居中間位置。一百五十米處勒避，其後從未參與競逐。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zoustar out of the Foxwedge mare Villami. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Theta and Stellar Express. This fellow had four starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1300m) and one placings. He was given four trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He sat not far off the pace and finished fifth, beaten by 4-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 3/4L, under pressure over 1050m AWT in Conghua on November 12. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)之後，在港同父馬包括「手機錶霸」及「星際快車」等駒，生母出自「楔位勁贏」(Foxwedge)。來港前在澳洲四戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1300米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘兩次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬4.25個馬位。最近11月12日出試從化泥地1050米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly, sent forward to race prominently, 1/2L back turning in, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時落後半個馬位。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, no clear run until 200M, blocked again 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉入直路時落後三個馬位。未能望空直至二百米處。一百五十米處再度受阻，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Jumped well from gate 9, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, didn't travel with much fluency early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，早段走勢欠順。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Clumsy start losing ground, soon recovered to forward of midfield on rail some 3L off the pace in 5th, angled out for a run entering straight but unable to quicken to threaten, hampered and faded 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之前第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位，但未能加速以構成威脅。受阻礙，五十米處力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) In midfield early stages before moving closer to track leaders entering home turn, driven final 200M and went to the line well. (Jockey - requested to take up a forward position from wide draw.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。入直路彎時追近，跟隨領先馬匹。最後二百米受催策。末段衝刺良佳。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓自外檔出閘的坐騎佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon dropped to last few, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上穩步上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Ridden to rear of midfield, steadied dropping to 8th passing the 800M, ran on steadily under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。跑過八百米處時收慢，墮居第八位。直路上在催策下穩步上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W) In last few despite ridden early dropping to last 800M out, swung widest into home straight, ran on past well-beaten runners near the stands side without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W) 儘管早段受催策，仍居最後數位之內。八百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時走最外疊。末段靠近外欄競跑，超越已洩氣潰敗的對手，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Settled mainly towards rear in 8th travelling keenly at times, shifted wide for a run into home straight, ran on well down the centre of the track to snatch 2nd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 大多居後列第八位，不時搶口。入直路時移出外疊以取位。沿跑道中央以佳勢上前，末段取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Unable to slot in from wide draw, caught wide in midfield and left without cover from 600M, ran home well enough final 300M to be beaten 1.5L at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，未能切入內疊，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺良佳，過終點時以一個半馬位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Chased leaders in 3rd, fought hard to stay in contention on straightening, couldn't keep up with leaders final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。入直路時力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米未能跟上領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 其士升降機及電扶梯讓賽

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處開始發力，走外疊。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Settled well behind from a wide barrier niggling along at times early stages, saved ground turning in for home, finished off the race well inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，遙居後列。早段數度受催策。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後三百米衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, angled out to make run 600m out, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處向外移出以上前。率先加速，直路初領先。二百米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，沿途居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in mid-division along the fence, couldn't finish off under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。在負頂磅下未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on outer, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至二百米處。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。跑過二百五十米處後望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Forced to steady shortly after start, raced in rear, pushed along 500m out, forced to steady 150m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被迫收慢，居後列。五百米處受推策。一百五十米處被迫收慢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, in rear, ridden along 600m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。六百米處受催策。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear, placed under pressure 550M but failed to respond to riding. (Trainer : disadvantaged by settling back / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。五百五十米處受催策，對催策毫無反應。（練馬師表示，此駒居後列不利發揮。／賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on well final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。最後二百米以佳勢追前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for clear run 400m out, one paced once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處須等待空位。望空後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, crowded 900m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。九百米處受擠迫。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, steadied near 600M, wider turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時收慢。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Three wide early stages, improved to tracked leaders 800m out, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段走第三疊。八百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。未能望空直至三百五十米處，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room top of home straight, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受緊迫。走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From a wide draw slotted into a 2-wide spot in midfield, brought wide 400M to challenge, finished off best final 200M to take 3rd close home. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百米衝刺最佳，接近終點時取得第三名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, raced in last pair, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，居最後兩位之內。未能望空直至二百米處。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, commenced move on top of home bend 700M out, ran on dourly down the centre of the straight to assert authority close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘，遙居於後。七百米處直路彎早段開始上前。直路上在跑道中央走勢強勁，接近終點時穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room behind leaders early in home straight and hampered 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初在領先馬匹之後空位不足，二百米處受阻礙，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, under pressure from 600M, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自六百米處起受催策。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (5W5W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, moved closer on turn, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(5W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎追近。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Keen in mid-field, tight for room briefly 300m out, weakened.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，搶口。三百米處一度受緊迫，其後轉弱。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Held up in rear, had to wait for run briefly 350m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 留居後列。三百五十米處一度須等待空位出現。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
