runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, strongly challenged by rivals 400m out, joined 200m out, stayed on strongly to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。四百米處受對手強勁挑戰。二百米處被追上。末段保持勁勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Held up 3-wide with cover in midfield, in similar position into home straight, one-paced without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 留居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the lead, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed leaders on outside, one of three that raced clear to halfway, reined back into third, starting to come under pressure when severely checked 350m out, soon lost ground and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 追迫領先馬匹，走外疊。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。收慢留居第三位，其後在催策下開始發力上前，三百五十米處大力勒避。瞬即失地及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led or disputed lead throughout, pressed on turning into home straight, headed 100m out, no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 沿途領先或爭奪領先。轉入直路時受催策。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Coulsty, who also sired High Cloud, out of the Dark Angel mare Elbegei. This fellow had one start for one win (a 2yo maiden over 1427m). He was given eleven trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second, beaten by 4-1/2Ls, under the whip over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 23. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: Coulsty之後，另一匹在港同父馬為「高韻」，來港前在愛爾蘭一出一捷，頭馬為一場1427米兩歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後十一次試閘一次上名。最近11月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段鞭策下跑第二名，落後頭馬4.5個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Niggled at early stages before settling towards rear in 10th on rail, tight on rail 400M out, kept on at the one pace without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，居後列的第十位，走內欄。四百米處在內欄受緊迫。末段保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W5W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W5W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 起步時被觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Impeded and forced to steady out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時受阻，被迫收慢，沿欄居中間位置。五百米處向外移出取位。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Soon taken across from a wide barrier for an inside run, travelled tight in rear before making steady headway home bend, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即切入內疊，居後列，緊迫競跑，直路彎穩步追前。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Held up last, still in last place and pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
Dropped right rein.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置，受推策，走大外疊。毫無表現。
右邊韁繩脫手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down in midfield but got shuffled back from 900M when the pace slackened, couldn't quite finish it off in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，但自九百米處起賽事步速減慢時墮退。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, crowded and checked 700m out, dropped to rear into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受擠迫及勒避。入直路時墮居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 500m out for clear run top of home straight, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄，直路初望空。末段走勢良佳，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, didn't quite have speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, disputed led final bend, headed top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。在領放下受追迫。直路彎爭奪領先。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From draw 3 obtained a 2-wide position ahead of midfield, urged along nearing 400M, ran home only fairly under pressure posing o threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時受催策。末段在催策下走勢僅屬一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, positioned 1 out 1 back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居第二疊第二位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, stayed on well and in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, followed winner through 300m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled well back after beginning from a wide barrier, switched wide into home straight, ran on past well-beaten horses and never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。入直路時向外移出。上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Obliged to make use in the early stages to take up a position outside the lead, tracked eventual winner into straight, battled on fairly, lost 2nd nearing 100M and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 早段須受催策以佔取領放馬外側的位置。入直路時跟隨頭馬，直路上走勢一般。接近一百米處時失去第二位，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently but trapped 3 wide, 2 wide from 700M, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Jumped on terms, chased leader in 2nd, quickened up well under top weight to lead mid-straight, just couldn't hold off winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位，追趕領放馬。在負頂磅下加速良佳，直路中段取得領先。僅最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Average to begin, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, hard ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, took the lead 100M, kept on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。跑過三百米處後受力策，對催策反應甚佳，一百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。

formguide.comments_eng: American PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Beau Liam out of the War Chant mare Annie Walker. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had four starts for two placings (including a 2yo group three over 1200m) in Britain & Ireland. He was given five trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat last and finished tenth, beaten by 14-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 20. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Beau Liam之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「戰歌」(War Chant)。來港前在英國及愛爾蘭出賽共四戰，上名兩次，包括一場1200米兩歲三級賽。抵港後五次試閘一次上名。10月13日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近11月20日出試田泥1200米，早段居包尾位置，末段力策下跑第十名，落後頭馬14.25個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Starspangledbanner out of the Peintre Celebre mare French Flirt. Horses by the same sire include Beauty Waves and Solid Win. This fellow had four starts for one win (a 2yo maiden over 1400m) and three placings (including a 2yo group three over 1427m). He was given six trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, under the whip over 1600m on turf in Conghua on November 6. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「花旗」(Starspangledbanner)之後，在港同父馬包括「美麗第一」及「一定掂」等駒，生母出自「名畫家」(Peintre Celebre)。來港前在愛爾蘭四戰得一勝三位，頭馬為一場1400米兩歲從未勝出馬賽，上名賽事包括一場1427米兩歲三級賽。抵港後試閘六次。最近11月6日出試從化草地1600米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第六名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, forced to steady 1000m out, switched three wide for clear run 550m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處被迫收慢。五百五十米處移出第三疊以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Settled well back from a wide barrier and waited with, ran on in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，遙居於後，留力候上。直路上追前，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 550M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, effort 500m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡。居中間之後位置。五百米處發力上前。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Chased leader, challenged and improved to lead top of home straight, soon headed by winner 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰及上前取得領先。二百五十米處瞬即被頭馬超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven on bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Prominent, joined the leader into straight holding every chance until finding no extra over 250M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列。入直路時追上領放馬，一度甚具爭勝機會，二百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Soon led under 7lb claimer, set steady pace and let down powerfully when asked from 350M, was strong through the line putting a good gap on the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 由獲減七磅的騎師策騎，早段瞬即帶頭競跑，以平穩步速領放。自三百五十米處起受催策，展開凌厲衝刺。帶離餘駒一段距離，以勁勢衝線掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Recovered quickly from an awkward start to soon take up running, held 1L advantage rounding home bend and into straight, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，瞬即取得領先。轉直路彎及入直路時領先一個馬位。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide without cover in midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, shifted back to 11th for cover 3-wide approaching first bend 1000M out, made no impression from wide into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處趨近首個彎位時留居第十一位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on okay, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持不俗走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, good headway halfway out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after awkward start, never any room to open up from 300m out, coasted past a few rivals final 150m, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，其後居後列。自三百米處起從未能望空。最後一百五十米輕鬆超越數匹對手。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) Mid division, forced to steady 900m out, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 居中間位置。九百米處被迫收慢。直路初移出外疊以望空。以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, no clear run until approaching 100M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近一百米處，其後追前頗多，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to just over 3L back in 6th on rail, gained 5th in a similar rail position on home bend about 750M out, not much room in straight until over 300M out, quickened well to take charge at the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第六位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。約七百五十米處於直路彎進佔第五位，居相若位置，仍走內欄。直路上空位不足直至三百米處。以佳勢加速，一百五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away with them, tracked leaders on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed good response in straight, took the lead 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳，五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Dropped back from wide draw to race at the rear, had the job ahead 400M 10L off the pace, couldn't launch a serious challenge and ran home fairly to a distant 8th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，其後墮居後列。四百米處落後領放馬頗遠，達十個馬位。未能展開真正挑戰，末段衝刺一般，取得第八名，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W5W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, went widest into home straight, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W5W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。入直路時走最外疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Settled ahead of midfield, 4Ls behind leader 400M, closed off well under pressure for equal 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，四百米處落後領放馬四個馬位。在催策下衝刺良佳，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, short of room 300m out to 200m out, eye-catching headway from rear final 100m, hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。三百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。最後一百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。接近終點時受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, some headway up rail in home straight but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。直路上沿欄略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, not enough room until approaching final 100M, kept on well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。空位不足直至趨近一百米處。保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, made no progress final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。最後一百五十米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, ridden top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路初受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, joined by rivals 600m out, headed top of home straight, stayed on well to fight back and lead 100m out, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入以領放。六百米處被對手追及。直路初被超越。末段保持佳勢，一百米處反先對手取得領先，僅勝。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Saxon Warrior out of the Intello mare Intuit. Horses by the same sire include Dragon Joy and Absolute Honour. This fellow had two starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1400m). He was given four trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fifth, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under a hold over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 19. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「碩信尚武」(Saxon Warrior)之後，在港同父馬包括「皇仁歡星」及「超開心」等駒，生母出自Intello。來港前在愛爾蘭兩戰得一勝，頭馬為一場1400米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘兩次上名。11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。最近11月19日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第五名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began only fairly from gate 1, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第一檔出閘僅屬一般。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W5W) Jumped only fairly and soon taken back from a wide draw to race at the rear, failed to pick up speed turning home and never involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W5W) 自大外檔出閘僅屬一般，瞬即留居後列。轉直路彎時未能加速。從未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, raced keenly throughout, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 900m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。九百米處被迫收慢。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen mid-race, improved to challenge 150m out, led 100m out, held on narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。一百五十米處上前展開挑戰。一百米處取得領先。以短距離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W2W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W2W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, ran on nicely early in the Straight, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初以佳勢追前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Sat handy on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。末段走勢強勁，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Tracked pace, caught wide and didn't settle fully, moved upsides leader top of home straight, seen off by that rival and no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，未能完全穩定走勢。直路初上前追逼領放馬，未能超越，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, tracked leaders, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to better than midfield in 6th early some 3L off the pace, badly crowded and dropped quickly out of contention 600M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段受催策，居中間之前第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位。六百米處嚴重受擠迫及迅速墮退，再無爭勝機會。從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速，二百米處領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced prominently, moved up to outside of leader before halfway, led 200m out, asserted and won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居前列。半程前推進至領放馬外側。二百米處取得領先。控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。末段以勁勢衝刺，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但終點線上不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made all, set strong pace, kicked 300m out, stayed on well, in control final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 沿途以快步速領放。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，最後五十米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, travelled smoothly, asserted from over 200m out under largely hand riding, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，走勢暢順。自二百米處起大多受推策，控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along early to lead, weakened in the Straight. (Barrier Manners and Performance Unacceptable)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段在催策下領先。直路上轉弱。（閘廂行為及表現均難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, joined by rival 200m out, quickened again and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。四百米處加速。二百米處被對手追及，再度加速，帶離對手勝出。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by King's Legacy out of the Savabeel mare Orchids. Horses by the same sire include Hero Rising and Golden Win. This fellow had six starts for three wins (including a 3yo listed over 1100m) and three placings (including a 3yo group three over 1200m). He was given four trials for two wins and one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by 3/4L, under pressure over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 15. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 2Ls under a hold over 1200m AWT in Conghua on November 19. He looks an interesting debutant here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「王者事蹟」(King's Legacy)之後，在港同父馬包括「喜駿昇星」及「金運齊來」等駒，生母出自「小法寶」(Savabeel)。來港前在澳洲六戰得三勝三位，頭馬包括一場1100米三歲表列賽，上名賽事包括一場1200米三歲三級賽。抵港後四次試閘得兩勝一位。10月15日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近11月19日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下以兩個馬位之先勝出。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield, a bit closer in the middle stages, cleared 250M, made some progress thereafter until inconvenienced 75M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。中段略為追近。二百五十米處望空。其後略為追前，七十五米處受妨礙。其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score by a nose.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，以鼻位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Settled just better than midfield in 5th, steadied and drifted back to midfield in 7th home bend, lost further ground in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間稍前第五位。直路彎收慢及墮居中間第七位。直路上進一步失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Raced very wide throughout, dropped to rear 700m out, bumped 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 沿途走大外疊。七百米處墮居後列。四百米處發生碰撞。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped nicely, sat outside lead, ran on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。末段以勁勢上前，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Commenced well from wide draw and across to lead, hung left under pressure home straight, headed 200m out, stuck to task but winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速後切入領放。直路上在催策下外閃。二百米處被超越。持續力拼，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled greenly, lay in throughout, difficult to be fully ridden out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢稚嫩。沿途內閃。難以被全力催策。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Quickly into stride, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Held up behind midfield 5-6Ls back, in similar spot turning for home, came with a decent finish but never likely to feature.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，落後五至六個馬位。入直路時居相若位置。衝刺不俗，但從未看似具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on outer, travelled keenly throughout the early stages, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。早段沿途搶口。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, followed runner-up into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。跟隨亞軍馬匹入直路。自四百米處起受催策，但未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前，獲得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover early stages, improved to track leaders two wide with cover 600m out, effort 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊，有遮擋。四百米處發力，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Caught wide no cover chasing leaders, had no extra final 200M and weakened out of contention. (Jockey - obliged to make use early stages to hold a forward position.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力，轉弱，再無爭逐機會。（騎師表示，他須於早段催策坐騎以佔取前列位置。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, didn't get best of runs early in home straight when trying to improve, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。直路初嘗試推進時取位不順。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch, pushed along to improve between horses from 300m out, led 100m out and soon in control, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起受推策以在馬匹之間推進。一百米處取得領先，瞬即控制大局，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Hampered shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Not far off 4-wide early stages, gradually improved to 2L 2nd 2-wide 900M out, kept on under pressure from a similar position into home straight but could find no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 早段落後領放馬不遠，走第四疊。逐漸上前，九百米處居第二位，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時位置相若，在催策下保持走勢，但最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Gradually recovered from moderate start to over 3L back in 5th about 1000M out, drifted further off the fast pace to some 4L back around home bend, renewed effort inside final 300M to do best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約一千米處居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。其後進一步落後步速快的領放馬，轉直路彎時落後約四個馬位。最後三百米重新發力，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。三百米處在催策下未能加速。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact with the left side of its starting gate, sent forward to race in 2nd, 3/4L back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，觸碰閘廂左側，受催策上前，居第二位，落後四分三個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped start, raced in midfield on the stands' rail, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, hard ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走外欄。中段略為追近。跑過三百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Became unbalanced after the start, showed pace on his debut to be racing close up behind leaders, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a pleasing 3rd on debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後失去平衡。今仗初出展現前速，緊隨領先馬匹。最後三百米持續力拼，跑獲季軍，首戰表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W1W) 自第九檔出閘後留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Deep Field out of the All Too Hard mare Laughen Hard. Horses by the same sire include Voyage Bubble and Self Improvement. This fellow had three starts for one win (a maiden over 1614m) and one placing. He was given three trials for one win in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he made all to win by a short-head under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「遙遠星空」(Deep Field)之後，在港同父馬包括「遨遊氣泡」及「自強不息」等駒，生母出自「情深義重」(All Too Hard)。來港前在澳洲三戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1614米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後三次試閘得一勝。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以短馬頭位之先勝出。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear, blundered near 850M, travelled keenly and made contact near 600M, 5 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。接近八百五十米處時失蹄。接近六百米處時搶口，與對手互相觸碰。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, checked 350m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百五十米處勒避。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Wide early, dropped to settle in rear of mid-field with cover 800m out, ridden top of home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 早段走外疊。八百米處墮居中間之後位置，有遮擋。直路初受催策，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 700m out, unable to improve position, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策。其後未能推進上前，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped ok and settled midfield one off the rail, angled out for a run 600M out, lacked a finishing effort and outsprinted (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出以取位。衝刺乏力，被超越。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Took up running after the first 200M, joined briefly approaching home turn from the 600M, kicked 1L clear soon after straightening, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 過了首二百米後取得領先。自六百米處起趨近直路彎時一度被追上。入直路後瞬即加速帶離一個馬位，保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly, responded nicely when asked, just missed (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢強勁。末段對催策反應良佳。僅敗。（見競賽事件報告。）
